name: Irodori-TTS v4.1 Small MF
description: 4-step MeanFlow Japanese TTS with voice cloning

paragraphs: Demo for Aratako/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small-MF, a Japanese text-to-speech model distilled from Aratako/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small with MeanFlow.

The rectified-flow (RF) teacher predicts the instantaneous velocity along the path from noise to audio latents and needs 40 sampling steps. The MeanFlow student learns the average velocity over an interval, so it can take much larger updates: at 4 steps it recovers most of the 40-step teacher's Japanese reading accuracy (JKYB-Parakeet target Kana-CER 7.67% vs 6.88%) and speaker similarity (JVS CAM++ 0.743 vs 0.752 at 30 s of reference), where 4-step RF collapses to 11.10% / 0.384.

Guidance is fused into the teacher targets during distillation, so inference uses one conditional DiT evaluation per step and there are no CFG knobs — CFG scales, Sway Sampling, noise truncation and speaker-KV scaling are all ignored for MeanFlow checkpoints.
features: Text → speech in Japanese, with automatic duration prediction. Output is 48 kHz.
Style captions — describe the voice, emotion and delivery in Japanese.
Zero-shot voice cloning — upload one or more reference clips (concatenated, up to 120 s).
Emoji style controls — insert control emoji (whisper, sigh, giggle, …) inline in the text.
Generated audio is watermarked with SilentCipher.
